title: AI 建筑外景时装大片，可复用 Zara / COS / Theory 官网首屏风格模板
author: Vigo Zhao (@VigoCreativeAI)
prompt_text: Create a high-end fashion campaign hero image for a modern apparel brand, inspired by Zara, COS, and Theory homepage editorials. Shoot two fashion models on monumental modernist stone stairs outside a contemporary museum or civic building. Use a low-angle wide lens, strong architectural lines, bright clear daylight, warm stone textures, clean blue sky, confident editorial poses, premium minimalist tailoring in black, ivory, camel, and sheer outer layers. Keep the composition 16:9 horizontal, ultra-photorealistic, polished commercial fashion photography, crisp fabric detail, realistic skin, controlled shadows, spacious negative sky, no logos, no text, no watermark.
tweet_intro:
评论区有人问：能不能用 AI 做那种建筑外景的时装大片？

就是 Zara、COS、Theory 官网首屏那种。

做了一组，4 个场景，零摄影师，零模特。

拆一下 👇🧵
notes:
Public fxtwitter metadata exposed the source status text and four sample images, but did not expose the comment/thread prompt. Public search also surfaced the author's AI-Visual-Prompt-Cookbook, but its Luxury Perspective Checkerboard Editorial style does not match these architecture-exterior fashion samples. This manifest therefore stores a clearly labeled reconstruction derived from the source status text and visible sample images, not a verified verbatim comment prompt.
Imported through link-prompt-import absorption workflow. Prompt template was manually decomposed into replaceable keyword slots and approved for direct generation with provenance caveat.
